issues.on_page: County Treasurer Balance at September 30, 2023: 113.80 (at October 1, 2022: 231.48)
issues.issue: County treasurer balances are printed below Exhibit A and are left out of cash and the balance sheet. That is defensible, since Exhibit A line 28 excludes them and the FY2024 beginning cash 18,158.41 ties to this ending. But the rules treat county treasurer balances as Cash and Cash Equivalents, so a person may want to decide whether 113.80 should be shown.
